customer_acct: Hey team — hitting reproducible parse failures from JSON mode for nested order arrays. Customer says parsing fails ~50% of the time and we've seen a billing spike from retries. Sample error: `ParseError: invalid JSON at position 102`

customer_acct: Here's a minimal response body we get sometimes from the API (streaming enabled):
```
{
  "orders": [
    {"id": "ord_001", "price": 12.3},
    {"price": 5.0, "item": "widget"}  // missing id, extra key ordering flips
  ]
}
```

mike_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request id or the top-level `x-request-id` from the response headers? Also what `json_mode` / model are you using?

customer_acct: Request ID: `rwd:20260310:abc123` — using `json_mode: array-items` + streaming = true, model pinned to `rwd-open-13b-v1` in the prod route.

mike_support: Got it. Reproducing locally now. Quick question: are you passing client-side retries on HTTP 5xx? That could cause duplicate partial streams and parsing errors.

jess: @mike_support I see an automated fallback in the routing logs for that request id: token validation briefly failed and we routed to `rwd-open-13b-compat` variant for continuity. That variant emits a slightly different nested schema (it includes `temp_id` and may omit `id` for partial items). That explains the missing `id` and extra keys.

sre_bot: [auto] RouteFallbackEvent: request=rwd:20260310:abc123 fallback_to=rwd-open-13b-compat reason=auth_intermediate_fail latency_ms=812

customer_acct: Oh — so is that why we saw the spike? We had client retries plus fallbacks producing extra responses and a billing jump.

devlin: Yes — when fallback happens mid-stream the consumer can see interleaved partial objects (one stream from primary model, then a short different-format chunk from the fallback). If the client concatenates and tries to parse as a single JSON stream it will break.

mike_support: Repro steps for next 10m: 1) curl the endpoint with streaming=true and json_mode=array-items; 2) set `Authorization` header to the same token the customer had; 3) force an auth invalidation (we can toggle on our side) to simulate fallback. I'll share an exact curl after I repro.

mike_support: Workarounds: - Pin to exact model variant (set `model: rwd-open-13b-v1` + `allow_fallback: false` in routing) to avoid schema drift during auth hiccups. - Turn off streaming until we push a fix, or add a defensive parser that validates per-item before combining. - Use `json_mode: strict` with a schema that requires `id` and fail early so you can surface clear errors instead of partial parse exceptions.

tara: Escalating to eng-runtime to track fallback schema compatibility. Tagging `@jess` and `@devlin` for the runtime change. Also adding billing team to investigate the cost spike; we should credit any out-of-policy charges while we root cause.

customer_acct: Appreciate it. For our immediate mitigation we'll disable streaming and pin the model. Please let us know when there's a permanent fix or when the fallback preserves schema.

mike_support: Thanks — creating internal ticket INF-2026-243 and will attach full logs + repro. I'll update this thread when we have a timeline. :thumbsup:
